title: Zesty Egyptian Chicken Croquettes
description: These peppery, springy chicken croquettes are coated in sesame seeds and pan-fried to a golden crisp, perfect for a low-sodium date night.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, almond flour, cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, minced garlic, lemon zest and black pepper until well mixed.
Stir in the beaten eggs until the mixture forms a firm, cohesive mixture that holds together when pressed.
Shape the mixture into 1 1/2 inch rounds and roll each in sesame seeds until evenly coated.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking.
Place the sesame‑seeded croquettes in the hot oil, cooking 3–4 minutes per side or until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F).
Remove the croquettes onto paper towels to drain any excess oil.
In a small bowl, whisk a spoonful of Greek yogurt with a pinch of black pepper and a dash of lemon zest to make a quick sauce.
Serve the hot croquettes with the yogurt sauce drizzled on top and a side of fresh parsley or mint for garnish.
